text:
Priya Singh: Heads-up — we are GA-ing the Hosted Toolcall Observability plugin to hosted API today. This adds tracing headers, per-tool latency breakdowns, and a new console view (Toolcalls → Observability). Rollout is gradual across regions. :tada:
Anna Chen: awesome — rough timeline? any expected client changes?
Priya Singh: rollout window is 2h starting 16:00 PT. No client SDK changes required, but customers who want richer traces should opt-in by sending the header `X-Redwood-Toolcall-Trace: 1`.
Miguel Ortiz: will there be any noise in metrics during canary? we should alert SREs if spike.
Mike Roberts: added an alert playbook to eng-sre, monitoring threshold = +30% p90 tool-latency for 5m. ops-bot: playbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/toolcall-observability
Jared Lo: will this increase per-request cost or rate-limit usage? customers asking.
Priya Singh: no change to billing for basic metrics. The detailed trace export (Trace Dump) is opt-in and billed under "debug exports" — see docs. Rate limits unchanged.
docs-bot: docs published: https://docs.redwood.ai/toolcall-observability (includes example curl + SDK snippet)
Anna Chen: example header snippet for engineering slack/channel? can you paste quick?
Priya Singh: sure:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/toolcall \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \ 
  -H "X-Redwood-Toolcall-Trace: 1" \ 
  -d '{"tool": "search", "input": "foo"}'
```
Miguel Ortiz: customers on Dedicated / Private — anything different?
Priya Singh: Dedicated gets the same feature but controlled by admin flag in the console (Admin → Feature flags → ToolcallObservability). Private packages will include the observability service; follow migration guide for on-prem.
Mike Roberts: ops note — canary keys created: tc-canary-001..005. If you see >5% error increase, revert canary keys.
Jared Lo: marketing comms? we should coordinate customer-facing announcement.
Miguel Ortiz: outreach planned — product will send an email to accounts with troubleshooting tips + links to the new console view.
Priya Singh: final notes: 1) deprecating the old "tool-timing" telemetry toggle on 2026-07-01 (customers should switch to the new header) 2) QA checklist posted in the runbook 3) Slack Q&A at 17:00 PT in #product. Please escalate any regressions to @eng-sre immediately. :white_check_mark:
